data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘numoon’, which means ‘to resuscitate’ or ‘to revive’. In Islamic tradition, Numaanah is a name given to girls, symbolizing the hope for the resurrection and new life after death.

in_arabic.name: نومَانَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: نومَانَة: اسُمهُ مُحِبُّ اللَهِ وَالمُحِبَّةُ الحَمِيدُ العَلِيمُ، الَّذي يُشَكِّكُ في عَطاءِ اللَهِ، وَيَعُدُّهُ عَطاءً عَظِيماً. الَّذي يُحِبُّ اللَهَ إِحسَاناً وَيُحِبُّ المُؤْمِنينَ وَالمُؤْمِناتَ. وَالحَمِيدُ: العَظيمُ الَّذي يُحِبُّ اللَهَ وَيَرجُوهُ وَيَخافونَ عَذابَهُ. وَالْعَلِيمُ: العَليمُ الحَكِيمُ العَظيمُ الَّذي يُحِبُّ اللَهَ وَيَرجُوهُ وَيَخافونَ عَذابَهُ. وَهَذَا الاسمُ يُشَكِّكُ في عَطاءِ اللَهِ وَيَنبُذُ المُؤْمِنينَ وَالمُؤْمِناتَ إِلَيهِ.

in_english.name: Numaanah
in_english.meaning: Beloved of Allah, the one who is beloved by Allah, praiseworthy, knowledgeable
in_english.long_meaning: Numaanah is a name that signifies being the beloved of Allah and being beloved by Allah. It also connotes praiseworthy and knowledgeable. The name Numaanah is rooted in the Arabic word 'num' which means to love or be loved. In Islamic tradition, Numaanah is seen as a name that represents the ideal qualities of a Muslim, including love for Allah and the desire to be loved by Him. It is also associated with the virtues of intelligence, wisdom, and humility.

data.cultural_impact: The name Numaanah holds a significant cultural impact within Islamic tradition. It is believed to have originated from the Arabic word ‘numoon’, which means ‘to resuscitate’, ‘to revive’, or ‘to revitalize’. This name is often given to babies as a sign of hope for prosperity, renewal, and new beginnings. The beautifully poignant meaning behind this name has deeply resonated with countless Muslim families over generations, and it continues to be a beloved choice for parents seeking a meaningful name for their child.
data.spiritual_significance: Numaanah carries deep spiritual significance in the Islamic faith. The name is believed to represent the ultimate act of Allah’s mercy and compassion towards His creation. The revival of life, symbolized by the name Numaanah, is a reminder of the chance for spiritual growth, redemption, and triumph over adversity that awaits us in both this life and the hereafter. By bestowing the name Numaanah upon their child, parents hope to instill in them a fundamental appreciation and longing for the power of new beginnings and the promise of eternal life in the sight of Allah.
